operations.label: Scout
operations.help: The game's Scout: the squad goes to the mark holding fire and watches the area for 10 min. Your side keeps what it sees on the map for 30 min instead of 15; a scouted enemy-held point stops paying its holder for 2 h.

operations.label: Sabotage
operations.help: Needs a sapper. The squad goes to a relay tower; the sapper plants a real demolition charge (20 s to plant) with a 45 s fuze and the squad falls back. Anyone can disarm it in time. If it goes off, the other sides get no contact reports for 60 min and the relay's holder loses its income for 2 h.

operations.label: Raid
operations.help: Walks in holding fire; must stay within 75 m of a harbour unseen for 2 min (being spotted restarts the clock). +90 supplies for you; every enemy commander loses 15. Your side can raid a harbour once every 6 h.
